channel.title: WIB Research Reports
channel.description: Original research from WIB's editorial team on India's healthcare, dining, travel, and consumer markets.

item.title: State of Indian Travel 2026
item.description: WIB's research on India's domestic travel landscape: 102 destinations, 12-month weather windows, weekend getaway analysis, state-by-state distribution.

item.title: State of Indian Restaurants 2026
item.description: WIB's annual research on Indian dining: 450 restaurants across 15 cities, cuisine concentration, premium-vs-budget split, city-by-city personalities.

item.title: State of Indian Hospitals 2026
item.description: WIB's annual research on India's hospital landscape: 236 multi-specialty hospitals across 15 cities, NABH coverage, specialty distribution, bed capacity.
